A '''forcefield cube''' was a security device employed by [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] to help guard ships from theft. The [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], [[The Maker (YT-1300 light freighter)|''The Maker'']], was protected by a forcefield cube at a [[Unidentified spaceport (Zelos II)|spaceport]] on [[Zelos II]]. However, its presence did not stop a [[T'Charek Haathi's Special Ops team|Special Ops team]] from stealing it.
